webhooks_secret_hint_desc: Only the prefix is stored for display. Rotate to get a new one.
webhooks_secret_shown_once_desc: It is shown only once. Store it in the receiver (for example an env var) and use it to verify the X-Trackr-Signature header.
webhooks_secret_copy_failed: Could not copy — select the text manually.
webhooks_how_to_verify_desc: Every request carries these headers. Recompute the HMAC over the raw body with your secret and compare in constant time.
webhooks_url_policy_note: Deliveries time out after 10 s. Anything other than a 2xx response is retried after 1 m, 5 m, 30 m, 2 h and 12 h; a webhook that keeps failing for days is disabled automatically.
webhooks_err_url_private: The endpoint must resolve to a public address (no localhost, LAN or link-local hosts).

webhooks_err_url_credentials: Remove the username/password from the URL.
webhooks_err_disabled_test: Enable the webhook before sending a test event.
api_keys_description: Personal access tokens for the JSON API. A key acts as the user it belongs to and inherits exactly that user's roles and permissions — nothing more.
api_keys_create_note: The key is shown once after creating.
api_keys_created_for: Acts as {name}. Hand it over through a secure channel.
api_keys_secret_shown_once_desc: It cannot be shown again. Only a hash is stored; if it is lost, revoke it and create a new one.
api_keys_empty_hint: Create a key for a user so a script or integration can call /api/v1 as them.
api_keys_field_user_hint: The key inherits this user's roles and permissions. For integrations, prefer a dedicated service user.
api_keys_revoke_message: Requests using this key fail immediately. {user} keeps their account and every other key. This cannot be undone.
api_keys_delete_message: Removes the key from this list. The audit log keeps its history.
api_keys_delete_message_active: The key is still active and stops working immediately. Removes it from this list; the audit log keeps its history.
api_keys_footnote: Keys only authenticate /api/v1 requests and attachment downloads, never the web app or account settings. They stop working when the user is banned or deleted.
api_keys_err_not_found: This API key no longer exists.
api_keys_err_user_forbidden: You can't create keys for this user.
api_keys_err_save_failed: Could not save the API key.
mcp_description: Let AI assistants (claude.ai, Claude Code, …) work in trackr through the Model Context Protocol. Access is off by default and enabled per user; inside MCP a user has exactly their own roles and permissions — nothing more.
mcp_setup_claude_ai_hint: claude.ai custom connectors use the same URL and sign in with OAuth: the user confirms on the trackr login page, then the assistant acts as them.
mcp_setup_api_key_hint: Scripts and other non-interactive clients can send a trk_ API key as a static bearer header (Authorization: Bearer trk_…) instead of OAuth. The key's user still needs MCP enabled here.
mcp_users_hint: Only users with MCP enabled can connect an assistant, with a token or an API key.
mcp_disable_message: Every assistant connected as {name} stops working immediately and their OAuth tokens are revoked. You can enable it again at any time.
mcp_connections_hint: OAuth tokens issued to MCP clients. API-key access is managed under API keys.
mcp_connections_empty_hint: Tokens appear here once a user with MCP enabled authorizes an assistant.
mcp_revoke_message: {client} loses access as {user} immediately and has to authorize again. This cannot be undone.
mcp_err_user_forbidden: You can't manage MCP access for this user.
mcp_footnote: Enabling MCP grants no extra permissions: an assistant sees and changes exactly what the user could in the app, and every write is recorded in the audit log.
mcp_instructions_hint: Appended to the instructions every MCP client receives when it connects. Use it for house rules: how tasks are worded, which projects or tags to prefer, what never to do. Keep it short — it costs context in every conversation.
mcp_instructions_placeholder: e.g. Write tasks in German. Never set a due date unless I say so. Tasks for KiloHertz go into the KHZ project.
mcp_instructions_builtin_note: The built-in instructions already tell assistants to stick to what you said: no invented descriptions, checklist steps or tags, and updates touch only the fields you asked for.
mcp_instructions_note_reconnect: Applies to new conversations — clients read instructions when they connect.
mcp_guides_hint: Longer reference documents the assistant reads on demand (get_guide tool): install tutorials, procedures, conventions. Write markdown, upload a .md file, or import a public web page — the assistant then takes its steps from there instead of guessing.
mcp_guides_empty_hint: Add one so the assistant plans steps from your documentation instead of making them up.
mcp_guide_delete_message: “{title}” will be removed and assistants can no longer read it.
mcp_guide_truncated_toast: The page was longer than the limit and has been truncated.
mcp_guide_upload_too_large: That file is larger than the guide limit.
mcp_guide_field_slug_hint: How the assistant refers to it: get_guide with slug “{slug}”, or trackr://guide/{slug}.
mcp_guide_field_summary_placeholder: e.g. Steps for setting up a new Proxmox server, from BIOS to first VM
mcp_guide_field_summary_hint: One line shown in the guide index — say what it covers so the assistant knows when to open it.
mcp_guide_field_source_hint: Public https page. Fetched once and converted to markdown; import again whenever the page changes. Pages rendered by JavaScript convert poorly — paste or upload the markdown instead.
mcp_guide_err_too_long: The text is longer than the limit.
mcp_guide_err_invalid_slug: Slug may contain lowercase letters, digits and dashes only (max 64 characters).
mcp_guide_err_slug_taken: Another guide already uses this slug.
mcp_login_consent_title: {client} wants to access trackr as you
mcp_login_consent_subtitle: Sign in to allow it. The assistant will see and change exactly what you can — nothing more.
mcp_login_not_enabled: MCP access is not enabled for your account. Ask a trackr admin to enable it under Settings → MCP, then try again.
